game.name: Install GeForce NOW
game.desc: Enables GeForce NOW (gfn-electron), a native-arm64 GeForce NOW client bundled in the image - no download needed. After enabling, restart EmulationStation and launch it from the GeForce NOW section in the main menu. First login: use your NVIDIA account or Discord (Google sign-in is blocked inside Electron). On-screen keyboard: hold the left Home button + tap the screen.

game.name: Uninstall GeForce NOW
game.desc: Hides the GeForce NOW (gfn-electron) section by removing its launcher. The bundled client stays in the image and your NVIDIA login under /storage/.config/gfn-electron is kept. The section disappears after restarting EmulationStation.
